Extended panel names below the main list must not become match-day players.
The bundled printed-text OCR model cannot reliably transcribe these names or

no invented 1–30 sequence and no false success claim. Original raw scans and
region OCR alternatives are kept as diagnostic artifacts outside source control.

Architecture correction: jersey-number/name spatial association is primary.
The circles in this photograph are optional visual aids for unresolved number
regions; plain, dotted, bracketed and underlined number forms are tested with
controlled OCR-box fixtures and actual browser OCR of no-circle list images.
